_: SolariNet status panel — committed parity fixture (CONTRACT-CP.md v1.1 §10).
_usage: The dashboard Panel page renders this deterministically at /?fixture=1 (no network). Each scenario's `history` is a chronological list of GET /api/panel `data` payloads, CADENCE seconds apart; the page resamples them into the 53-deep client history rings exactly as it does live. v2 adds the CONTRACT-AW §3.1 `gear` array (screen A1's flow gates) and the §3.3 `panelScreenConfig` on the newest sample of each scenario.
_gearInventory: `gear` is in §3.1 wire order — router, switch, hubs, aps, wanBackup — and stands for the real 9-device inventory verified 2026-08-07: chemistry (UDM Pro Max, router), laboratory (USW Pro Max 16, switch), Test Tube / pipette / slide (USW Ultra, hubs), beaker / flask (U7 Pro) + cyclotron (U7 Pro XGS) (aps), covalent (U5G Backup, wanBackup). role 0=router 1=switch 2=hub 3=ap 4=wanBackup; state 0=down 1=up 2=degraded (NOT the PanelState enum); rx/txLevel 0..7, 0 = idle.
_screenConfig: `panelScreenConfig` is the panel's own report of its persisted rotation config (§3.3): 12 entries, bit0 enabled and bits1..3 weightCode (0=1/4x 1=1/2x 2=1x 3=2x 4=5x 5=10x). A DIFFERENT accepted wire shape is used per scenario on purpose — normal: packed bytes; alarm: objects; stale: 24-char hex; emptyHistory: absent (panel has not reported); noData: malformed, which must read as unknown and never as the factory default.

scenarios.label: Normal · quiet fleet
scenarios.note: All 15 roster systems up, 12 samples of history: every ribbon, histogram and trace is fully populated. panelState reports theme C screen 2, auto-brightness on, dwellSec 6 (a preset, shown as selected).

scenarios.label: Alarm · tier-0 down, unacknowledged
scenarios.note: RADIUM (CORE, tier 0) down and NEON degraded → score 100, alarmActive, unacknowledged episode 4211. Exercises the universal inlay, the beacon, the D1 ticker, the control pending/failed states via recentCommands, and dwellSec 3.

scenarios.label: Stale · upstream data older than 30 s
scenarios.note: Same fleet as normal but dataStale=1 and panelState.reportedAt 4 minutes old. A2 lane 1 (host data freshness) goes to full backlog; the page shows the staleness chip. dwellSec 0 = the panel has never reported a dwell, so no interval is marked selected.

scenarios.label: Empty history · first poll only
scenarios.note: One sample. Every history ring holds a single filled slot, so C0's ribbon, C1's traces and A1's WAN ramps must render from the oldest-real-sample clamp rather than blank or flicker. panelState is null — the panel has never reported.

scenarios.label: No data · zero-node fleet
scenarios.note: CONTRACT §9: a zero-node fleet is valid data, not an error. All 12 tiles must render the NO DATA treatment, not a blank board. dwellSec 12 is deliberately not one of the 3/6/30 presets: the page must report the value without marking any button selected.
